Lens & Light Studio — Wedding Photography & Cinematography, Jaipur

Lens & Light Studio is a boutique wedding photography house based in Jaipur,
specializing in candid storytelling, traditional portraits, and same-day
highlight reels. Founded by a husband-wife team, they cover roughly 40 weddings
a year across Rajasthan and have a recognizable warm, film-inspired editing
style.

Their standard wedding package (two days, two photographers, one
cinematographer) is priced at ₹1,85,000, including an engagement shoot and a
printed album. Drone coverage is an add-on at ₹25,000.
